instagram.author: all.things.nwa
instagram.body:
One of the hardest dinner reservations in NWA is hiding in downtown Rogers. 👀

Heirloom at The 1907 serves a very small group each night—roughly 18 to 22 guests—and the tasting menu changes as the kitchen develops new ideas.

That means you are not just ordering an entrée and leaving. You are sitting down for a full experience built around eight to 10 courses. 🍴

The current fixed price is $145 per person before beverage pairings or other drinks, so yes, this is firmly in the splurge category.

Chef and co-owner Jason Paul also earned a spot among the 2026 James Beard finalists for Best Chef: South. That is a massive accomplishment for a restaurant this small.

Whether it is the most luxurious restaurant in all of Arkansas is up for debate. But it is easily one of the most distinctive dining experiences in Northwest Arkansas.

Is it worth the splurge to you?
